name: Jev Run Brief
description: The prompts for JevRunBriefWriter, the cheap, tool-free agent that performs structured note-taking compaction between a JevAgent's iterations. The writer reads the previous brief and fresh numbered events, then returns only new high-signal notes as verbatim event passages with event ids; code verifies and appends them to the goal-plus-notes aggregate. The update prompt carries the original request, previous brief, and bounded new events. Its placeholders are {request}, {previous_brief}, {first_event}, {last_event}, and {events}.
